thread:
Shilpa: Heads-up — planning a tenant-scoped key-extraction sim next Wed 09:30 PT. Goal: validate detection + containment for an operator trying to export a customer wrapping key via our KMS-proxy -> HSM path. Need input on minimal RBAC changes, audit evidence to collect, and IR playbook tweaks.

Kevin: Oncall will be paged for anomalies. What's the minimum RBAC delta you need? Keep it narrowly scoped. :eyes: 

Shilpa: Proposed minimal delta: ephemeral grant `kms:GenerateWrappedKey` and `kms:ImportKeyMaterial` to a proxy test service account for one test-key. Scope to a single tenant, TTL 1h, no broad wildcards.

Maria: Two policy cautions: 1) Use a `Condition` binding for `DateLessThan` and `resource.name` == that synthetic test key. 2) Tag the request with `testing:sim=true` and ensure proxy logs surface that tag for filtering. Also set proxy log retention to 90d for the run.

Tom: Compliance asks: SOC2 evidence bundle + signed run report. Need IAM change ticket, pre-sim opt-out notification for BYOK customers, and HSM chain-of-custody artifacts.

Kevin: Ops runbook: snapshot current IAM bindings, create ephemeral creds via `aws sts assume-role`, execute export attempt in controlled network, capture: proxy logs, HSM audit logs, KMS audit events, host process list, and packet capture of the session.

Shilpa: Suggested audit filters: `resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:("GenerateWrappedKey" OR "ImportKeyMaterial")`. Proxy should log request/response headers (redact secrets) and include `testing:sim=true`. Posting sample IAM snippet.

Shilpa: ```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:GenerateWrappedKey"],
      "Resource": "projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/tenant-test/cryptoKeys/synthetic-test-key",
      "Condition": {"DateLessThan": {"aws:CurrentTime": "2026-03-25T18:30:00Z"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

Maria: Add `kms:RequestTag/testing-run = true` to the policy and ensure HSM audit includes operator-id and firmware-version. If HSM supports dual-operator enforcement, enable it for the test.

Tom: Add compliance controls: 1) JIRA pre-approval with Security + Legal signoff. 2) Post-sim signed assertion (no secrets exfiltrated) plus artifacts list. Also require outreach to regulated customers with opt-out window.

Kevin: IR plan: immediate revocation of ephemeral role + rotate canary key on any sign of leakage. Don't rotate real BYOK keys; instead use tenant-scoped canary keys. Document timeline in `#incidents` and file a blameless post-run finding.

Shilpa: Question: for BYOK tenants where customers hold private material, should we run this in their tenant? I propose we only run synthetic-key sims and never touch customer private keys. Thoughts?

Tom: Agreed — do NOT touch customer-owned private keys. Use synthetic wrapping keys created in the tenant and make the sim explicit in the approval ticket. For regulated customers require explicit opt-in.

Maria: I'll draft the runbook fragment: exact log retention (90d), sample queries, HSM audit fields (operator-id, command, signature, firmware-version), and the artifact checklist. Will post by EOD.

Kevin: I'll update oncall playbook to page SRE + SecEng on any `GenerateWrappedKey` events and include link to the JIRA ticket.

oncall-bot: Reminder: maintenance window Wed 09:00-10:30 PT. Pager escalation enabled for sim. Use `#incidents` for anything real.

Shilpa: Thanks everyone — I'll open the JIRA, mark the keys synthetic, and post final RBAC snippet. :pray:
summary: tenant-scoped key-extraction sim planning: RBAC, logging, compliance, IR
